metadata.notes: Baseline for sift-email with the AI/Bulk label and the rubric's Newsletters section (PR #125), evals 1-25, two runs each, with run-mcp-trials.sh against the Gmail, Claude Docs, and Contacts stubs. Runs 1 and 2 were on SKILL.md as of commit 98f73e5. Review commit e7dfc56 then tied the newsletter label to the rubric's Category labels section and tightened the Newsletters prose; evals 22 and 24 were run once more on that text and checked by hand against their label and rubric expectations (both passed, and eval 24 applied AI/Newsletter to the new club notice), but the full suite was not rerun. Every eval prompt starts with /sift-email. Both runs were on 2026-10-23 in the rubric timezone (2026-10-24 in UTC for eval 1, whose starter rubric is UTC); fixtures are anchored to 2026-10-10, and graders held the run date to the date the run's clock gave. Failures: eval 1 run 1 (the log summary linked the rubric but not the log), eval 11 run 2 (read the whole rubric before the Step 2 checks), eval 17 run 1 (looked up a sender About me already covered), eval 18 run 1 (no Needs reply on the lease, whose Oct 15 deadline had passed by the run date; the previous baseline ran on Oct 12), eval 24 run 2 (left AI/Newsletter off a one-line club notice), and eval 25 run 2 (missed a label swap found only through the log, so no question was opened). Not graded: the Bulk and Junk split for marketing mail varies between runs (eval 18: 33 Bulk and 0 Junk in run 1, 22 and 11 in run 2; eval 21's one-off sale was Junk in run 1 and Bulk in run 2); log lines sometimes leave out AI/Sifted; unrequested (inferred) About me notes; and an em dash in one question comment (eval 6 run 2).
